verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents self-service forwarding of physical items "wherever you need them" and lists expedited and international shipment fees plus postage, so a basic forwarding capability with some shipping tiers exists. Nothing shows how forwarding is triggered or what the operator sees before confirming. Missing for 10: rule-based or one-click forwarding, saved recipient addresses, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
